calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark, compute the negative open-to-close return for each completed session and take its trailing three-session mean. Higher values indicate recent intraday weakness and are expected to predict short-horizon reversal.
calculation.timing: Computed only from completed daily OHLC observations through the decision date minus one session.

regime_notes.interpretation: Positive and stable across all tested regimes; predictive strength decays beyond one day but remains positive at 5d and 10d.

validation.universe: 15 tradable benchmark instruments; each daily cross-section required at least 8 valid instruments

signal_provenance.artifact: recomputable from ../persistent/stock_data/{symbol}.csv using the calculation expression
